projects.title: Enhancing Website-Fingerprinting
projects.description:
The Classifiers Modeling with re-training them over a finite time series to maintain the accuracy at higher values of k - means. Designed ensemble classifiers in order to increase the overall accuracy to 93.93% from 85% (Majority Voting and Bagging).
Background:
Webpages are constantly changing their contents. As a result, staleness of the data increases over time. Website Fingerprinting is to predict the website destination. It is the traffic analysis of network packets, exchanged between a client browser and a server to load the main page of a website on the client’s browser. For each classifier, we used at time t=0 it classifies up to 90% of accuracy. As time passes of data over 90 days, the accuracy drops extremely fast in current experiment it takes less than 10 days to drop under 50%.
